description: Tracks a submitted petition/comment's outcome (ADR-2605312400 §3, moushibumi_status_track): 議会 受理 → 採択/不採択, or agency 公示 of 提出意見を考慮した結果及びその理由 (行政手続法 §43). CONSTITUTIONAL: track only, no coercion (G11); any member-identifying outcome detail lands ONLY in an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* DID-bound envelope (G6) — this record holds status metadata + pointers, never inline content. Outcome publication is aggregate-first + 1 SBT = 1 vote for named matters (G11).

memberDid.description: The 請願者/意見提出者本人 (G4)

submissionRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the submissionRecord being tracked

state.description: Petition 採択/不採択 or agency §43 response state

outcomeRef.description: Pointer to the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope holding outcome detail (G6); never inline

publicOutcomeUri.description: Optional public URL of the agency's §43 考え方 公示 / 議会 議決 (non-PII public record)
